purpose: Exploratory CASE logo mockups; not installed app assets

concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: high-end visual identity exploration board for CASE, a private desktop meeting companion that listens locally, remembers decisions, and offers brief helpful nudges. Brand character: reliable, practical, quiet, observant. Create original professional graphic design, extremely refined proportions, vector-friendly flat artwork. Exact product name: CASE (uppercase, spelled C A S E). No acronyms, no other brand names. Inspiration is the practical articulated companion idea, never a movie robot replica or movie branding. Palette: warm paper #F1EFE8, graphite #22241F, restrained muted amber #C39552; one small optional dusty blue #607F99 detail. Strong negative space and precise optical spacing. Render a crisp landscape design presentation with generous margins: large primary logo lockup occupying left two-thirds; right column shows the same exact mark as a desktop rounded-square app icon and in reverse on dark graphite; a bottom strip shows a few small one-color reductions. The same design must be consistent across all applications. Typography and symbols absolutely sharp. Only labels allowed are CASE and a small direction number. No explanatory paragraphs, watermarks, gradients, sparkles, microphones, speech bubbles, brains or generic AI symbols. Direction number 01. Primary request: TYPOGRAPHIC identity. Design a bespoke uppercase CASE wordmark with an architectural grotesk character, broad but not excessively extended letterforms, carefully designed squarish C with subtly softened corners, a strong distinct A, a balanced S, and open E. Introduce one restrained amber joint/cut in the C that gives this letter an ownable standalone icon. The wordmark should feel like precise industrial lettering softened for a personal software companion, not science-fiction stencil lettering. Use the custom C as the standalone app icon; ensure it comes from the C in the wordmark. Large lockup on warm paper. Avoid a separate illustrative symbol.

A credible crafted software identity, not esports, crypto, or aerospace branding.
